item.title: github: GitHub Copilot in JetBrains, Ignite releases
item.description:
GitHub Copilot for JetBrains adds remote access, on-device voice dictation, browser use controls, and context usage shortcuts. The update also includes historical diffs and other simplifications for JetBrains IDE users.

  • Source: GitHub
